title: Login roles with expired validity
description: The current checkpoint is 100. Return only roles with can_login = 1 and a non-NULL valid_until_seq below 100. Return exactly two columns: role_name, valid_until_seq. NULL means no expiration and must be excluded. Sort by valid_until_seq ASC, then role_name ASC.
hints: Comparison with 100 already excludes NULL, but can_login is still a separate condition.
Roles with the earlier validity checkpoint come first.
solution_explanation: A NOLOGIN role or a role without an expiration is not an expired login role.
